summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of David Hammarwall as new Head of Business Area Networks, effective October 1, 2026. He succeeds Per Narvinger, who becomes President and CEO of the company on the same date. The filing contains no financial terms, transaction details, board recommendations, or advisors—it is purely an executive personnel change. No shareholder vote or regulatory approvals are required. This is a routine management succession filing, not a special situation. Therefore, it does not fall under any merger or special-situations category beyond a standard management change announcement.
